tiers.name: Licensed
tiers.note: Real microdata that leaves the building — after an application, a licence, or organisational accreditation. Free in most cases; the gate is institutional identity, not money. Every licence in this tier prohibits redistributing the data, and most restrict what can be published from derivatives.

tiers.name: Secure enclave
tiers.note: The richest data in the world — full-population income, tax, and benefit registers — under the tightest architecture: remote analysis environments where unit records are never seen or downloaded. In several of these countries the national tax–benefit model is itself a service inside the enclave.
